column1: # Shared public-IP policy vectors. Columns: address, go, swift (allow|deny).
# Go = desktop/internal/steamaccel publicIP (home path, authoritative deny list).
# The ONLY intended difference: 64:ff9b::/96 (well-known NAT64) with an embedded public IPv4 is
# allowed on the phone (IPv6-only carriers) and denied on the home path. The embedded IPv4 is still
# checked on the phone. Carrier-specific NAT64 prefixes look like global IPv6; that is residual.
# Zone ids are stripped by Swift; Go's net.ParseIP rejects them, so both fail closed on non-public.
# --- IPv4 denied: each Go deny prefix, first and last address and one in the middle
# --- IPv4 public: addresses immediately outside each denied range
# --- IPv4-mapped IPv6 follows the embedded IPv4
# --- 64:ff9b::/96 well-known NAT64: the single documented Go/Swift difference
